name: omnipost-video
description: Multi-platform video publisher for YouTube & Instagram Reels with Gemini AI trend analysis

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:client && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p release-bundle/omnipost-video && cp -r dist public package.json .env.example README.md Dockerfile docker-compose.yml release-bundle/omnipost-video && cp -f package-lock.json release-bundle/omnipost-video/ 2>/dev/null || true && cd release-bundle && tar -czf ../omnipost-video-standalone.tar.gz omnipost-video && cd .. && rm -rf release-bundle
